name: tabular_custom_estimators
title: Two hand-written BaseEstimator transformers and a FunctionTransformer inside a ColumnTransformer, tuned with GridSearchCV
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-tabular: the custom-estimator false-positive trap

forbidden.why: learning state from the rows you were handed is what fit means; WinsorizingTransformer.fit and RareCategoryGrouper.fit are called by the Pipeline once per fold and there is no split in this file to come before
nothing is fitted before the split at line 21; GridSearchCV.fit at line 29 is given the training half and refits the whole Pipeline per fold
pipeline.py assembles steps and calls fit on nothing at all
test_x reaches exactly one call, search.predict_proba at line 39
the X a custom transformer's fit receives is a fold's training half by construction; it carries no VAL_SPLIT or TEST_SPLIT tag and never could
GridSearchCV is given build(), a Pipeline whose first step is the ColumnTransformer - which is exactly the fix MLV103 asks for
there is no timestamp in this project
np.random.seed at line 34, and random_state=SEED on the split, the folds and the forest
train_test_split and StratifiedKFold both pass random_state=SEED
classification_report is fed `predictions`, produced by a threshold comparison and .astype(int) at line 40; roc_auc_score is in the score-metric carve-out
roc_auc_score is given search.predict_proba(test_x)[:, 1], a score column
these are sklearn BaseEstimator subclasses, not torch modules; they have no super().__init__() to call and sklearn's clone contract forbids doing work in __init__
self.keep_ is a dict of learned category sets, not a container of submodules, and this is not a torch model

notes: MLV117 (train_test_split without stratify=) is catalogued but not implemented, so it cannot carry a forbidden label; for the record, in train.py: the split passes stratify=labels
